top_stories.title: Congress will face setback in 2028 Assembly elections: Former BJP MLA Narasimha Naik - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Narasimha Naik**, a former **BJP** MLA, stated that the **Congress** will face a setback in the 2028 Assembly elections without outgoing Chief Minister Siddaramaiah.  He expressed disappointment over Mr. Siddaramaiah's resignation and believes it will be a challenge for the new leader, **D.K. Shivakumar**, to lead the party effectively. Naik compared this situation to former Chief Minister B.S. Yediyurappa's resignation, suggesting that the **Congress** will face similar consequences.

top_stories.title: True Gen-Z defined by both its culture and contribution towards nation building: BJP president Nitin Nabin | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **BJP** national president Nitin Nabin addressed concerns about India's Gen Z, calling for an open debate on its definition and contribution to nation building.  He emphasized the need to guide this energy in a positive direction, citing examples of youth-led movements in neighboring countries that have led to instability. Nabin also cautioned against labeling young people as "anti-establishment" and highlighted the importance of nurturing their potential for progress. He stressed the role of the government in providing direction and support for India's youth, particularly in areas like employment and education.

top_stories.title: Congress will face setback in 2028 Assembly elections: Former BJP MLA Narasimha Naik - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Narasimha Naik**, former **BJP** MLA, claims that the **Congress** will face a setback in the 2028 Assembly elections without outgoing Chief Minister **Siddaramaiah**.  He argues that **Siddaramaiah's** forced resignation weakens the party and presents challenges for new leader **D.K. Shivakumar**. Naik believes this situation mirrors the impact of former Chief Minister **B.S. Yediyurappa's** resignation, suggesting a potential victory for the **BJP** in 2028.

top_stories.title: Firing incident indicates deteriorating law and order, says Pralhad Joshi - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Union Minister Pralhad Joshi** expressed concern over the deteriorating law and order situation in **Dharwad**, citing a recent firing incident as an example. He alleged involvement of high-level officials, including police officers, in the case due to their failure to arrest the prime suspect, **Sundar Pal**.  Joshi also criticized the police for not including the accused's name in the FIR until media reports prompted action.

top_stories.title: INDIA Bloc Revival In Bengal? Support For Mamata Banerjee Over Nephew's Assault
top_stories.rephrased_article: Despite losing the Bengal election, **Mamata Banerjee**'s stature within the **INDIA** bloc remains strong. Opposition leaders condemned the assault on her nephew, **Abhishek Banerjee**, by a mob in Sonarpur, South 24 Parganas.  **Mallikarjun Kharge**, **Akhilesh Yadav**, and **Arvind Kejriwal** accused the BJP of fostering political violence, while the ruling party denied involvement and blamed the TMC for mischaracterizing public anger. The incident has led to calls for stronger law-and-order measures in West Bengal.

top_stories.title: Punjab civic polls: Early edge to Congress as counting proceeds amid tight security - India Today
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Congress** is surging ahead in the early stages of counting for **Punjab's** civic body elections, with strong performances in several municipal wards.  The counting process began on Friday amidst heavy security deployment at multiple counting centers across the state. The AAP, BJP, and SAD are also contesting the elections, which are being viewed as a key indicator of the political mood ahead of next year's Assembly elections. A total of 7,555 candidates contested the election, with **Congress** leading in several wards.  The outcome is expected to serve as an important indicator of the political mood in Punjab ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections.

top_stories.title: 'Enhancing Capabilities For China, Pakistan's 2-Front Challenge': Navy Chief
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Indian Navy** has enhanced its anti-submarine warfare capabilities, underwater surveillance, and network-centric operations to counter potential threats from China and Pakistan.  **Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi**, the Navy Chief, stated that these efforts are not directed at any specific nation but aim to secure India's maritime interests. The **Indian Navy** is focusing on credible deterrence through technological integration, sustained presence, and operational readiness, including the acquisition of six stealth submarines under Project 75(I).  The **Navy** is also committed to achieving self-reliance in defense by building its own platforms and industrial capabilities.

top_stories.title: Congress’s message to Siddaramaiah as DKS takes charge: Won’t allow you to rest - Karnataka News | India Today
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Congress** general secretary **KC Venugopal** declared that the party will not allow former Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah to rest, urging him to continue playing an active role in both state and national politics.  After Siddaramaiah's resignation, **DK Shivakumar** was unanimously elected as the new CLP leader and formally named Karnataka’s next Chief Minister.  Siddaramaiah congratulated Shivakumar and called for a "second freedom struggle" to protect the country's unity and integrity. The Congress leadership expressed confidence that under Shivakumar's leadership, they will return to power in the 2028 elections.

top_stories.title: Donald Trump’s daughter visits Taj Mahal
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Tiffany Trump**, daughter of **Donald Trump**, visited the Taj Mahal with her husband, **Michael Boulos**, on Saturday.  She toured the monument extensively and expressed interest in its history and architecture. Security was heightened for the visit, with a high-security corridor established from the airport to the Taj Mahal. After leaving the monument, she returned to her hotel with **Boulos** and will continue their India trip.

top_stories.title: DK Shivakumar To Be Sworn In As Karnataka CM On June 3 | OdishaBytes
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Siddaramaiah** resigned as chief minister of **Karnataka**, paving the way for **DK Shivakumar** to become the new leader of the **Congress Legislative Party**.  The formal election took place on Saturday with **Shivakumar** being elected by a unanimous vote from the CLP. He will be sworn in as the next **Karnataka** chief minister on June 3rd. The focus now shifts to selecting deputy chief ministers under **Shivakumar**.
